name: The Fall of Elior Forest & Emilia's Glaciation
description: Pandora and Regulus Corneas attack the hidden elven settlement. Petelgeuse absorbs the Sloth Witch Factor to protect young Emilia. In sheer despair, Emilia unleashes boundless ice magic, freezing herself and the entire forest for nearly a century.

source.title: Arc 4 Bonds of Ice & Flashback Chapters

name: Outbreak of the 10-Year Demi-Human War
description: Rising political disenfranchisement explodes into a devastating civil war across Lugunica between human loyalists and demi-human rebel factions led by Valga Cromwell.

source.title: EX Volume 2: Sword Devil Battle Ballad

name: Theresia van Astrea Draws the Dragon Sword & Ends the War
description: Mastering the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint, Theresia unsheathes the Dragon Sword Reid, crushing the rebellion's command and forcing peace treaties, subsequently marrying Wilhelm Trias.

source.title: EX Volume 3: Sword Devil Love Song

name: Fall of the Sword Saint: Theresia Perishes against the White Whale
description: Theresia leads the Royal Knight expedition to slay the White Whale. In the midst of combat, her Sword Saint blessing suddenly transfers to 5-year-old Reinhard, leaving her vulnerable to fatal strikes.

name: The Kidnapping of Princess Felt from the Royal Villa
description: The newborn royal princess is secretly abducted from the palace nursery by shadowy conspirators and presumed lost, eventually growing up in the slums unaware of her royal blood.

name: The Witch Cult Exterminates the Oni Clan
description: Cultists raid the secluded Oni village, butchering the clan. Ram loses her horn protecting Rem before Roswaal arrives to rescue the surviving twin sisters.

name: Stride Vollachia's Insurrection in the Empire
description: Stride Vollachia, allied with the Kurgan clan and rogue authorities, stages an insurrection against the Vollachian throne, testing the empire's imperial line of succession.

name: Wilhelm Trias Earns the Moniker 'Sword Demon'
description: A fiercely disciplined youth, Wilhelm carves through rebel ranks with singular obsession, earning terror and awe across the battlegrounds as the ruthless 'Sword Demon'.

source.title: EX Volume 2: Sword Devil Battle Ballad

name: Exile of Rom: Valga Cromwell Shelters in the Royal Slums
description: Following the collapse of the demi-human uprising, commander Valga Cromwell goes into deep hiding under the alias 'Old Man Rom', establishing a scrap warehouse that becomes an underground refuge.
